a16_0932925.text: There. Okay, Charlie. If you got some time, I'd like for you to check me on these angles.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: [Garble]. Hey, Ken. You've got to stay in Min Dead Band Att hold until I tell you.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Charlie, you gonna put your foot on the...

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Minus - subtract that. That'll be 6 - that one's correct. 289.36. That one is correct. This is wrong here. 360 minus should be a 370 something.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: You got 340 - Yeah, that's a minus.

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Now add that up again and make sure it makes 360.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Yeah. Seven and three is ten; five and four is 9, ten, five and four is nine, 101 there we go.

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Okay. Okay. Closed and secured hatch.

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: You did the self-test already, huh, John?

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Okay. Plus 293.76, plus 289.36, plus 355.43. Go. Go get them, tiger. Okay.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Yeah, you - he - he was out of attitude, wasn't he?

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Maybe you ought to wait until that No Att light goes out.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: It ain't gonna ever go out.

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Oh, that's right. You got to release. You're right. Not until you do that, it won't go out.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Now, they said they're gonna change the REFSMMAT, right ?

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Why, what do you want to do?

a16_0932925.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: You can still set the REFSMMAT flag.

a16_0932925.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0932925.text: Yeah, I don't see why not.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (comm)
a16_0942144.text: Ken, are we pretty close to being at the undocking attitude?

a16_0942144.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0942144.text: Undocking attitude is 01 plus 40.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Yeah, we're pretty close.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (CM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Okay.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: What time did they say AOS was, Ken?

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: The reason I ask, Ken, is for this P52, I need to be close to the right attitude to pick up the stars.

a16_0942144.speaker: Mattingly (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: It's the same set of timeline procedures we've been using.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: I know it. It's just that it's further off on the 8-ball than normal.

a16_0942144.speaker: Mattingly (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Is that gonna be close enough, John?

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Yeah. I think...

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Oh, let's try it and see what happens.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Okay. We just got them.

a16_0942144.speaker: Mattingly (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Charlie, [garble] AOS any second.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: Hello, Houston. Ole Orion; how do you read? Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Orion, this is Houston. Read you loud and clear.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: Okay, Jim. We're zipping right on through the checklist. We got the PGNS up, the docked coarse align done, the landing gear's deployed, and the only thing we haven't done is really what you need to see. And we're ready to start in on the S-Band checks and bring up the steerable. Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Okay, Charlie. [Pause.]

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: Okay, while guidance is - Let me give you some angles. We had a Verb 06 Noun 20 that was done at 94:20:20. The LM angles were plus 29465, plus 28996, plus 35502. [Pause.]

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Roger; we copy. Copied the LM as plus 29465, plus 28996, plus 35502. Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: That's affirmative. The Command Module are plus 00269, plus 10931, plus 00472. Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Roger. I copied plus 00269, plus 10931, plus 00470 [sic]. Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: That's affirm. It sounds like we've got good comm on Primary S-band and T/R and Secondary Power Amp. I'm going Secondary S-Band T/R and Primary Power Amp. Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Roger. We're standing by.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: Okay. I think it's my switch you're doing.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young
a16_0942144.text: Huh? Yeah, it is. Carry on.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Okay.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Try your other one.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: See, it doesn't do it here.

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Casper, this is Houston. We want narrow on the S-band. [Pause.]

a16_0942144.speaker: Mattingly (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: You've got it.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young
a16_0942144.text: [Weak.] Okay, Jim. How do you read the old CDR? [Long pause.]

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Wait a minute. Let's get locked up here.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Okay.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young
a16_0942144.text: Is that affirmative?

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: Yeah, you - go ahead. You ought have him.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young
a16_0942144.text: Okay, Jim; how do you read? Over. [Pause.]

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Orion, this is Houston. Go ahead.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: How do you read, Jim? Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: I read you, but there's a lot of noise in the background. [Pause.]

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: Okay. We have Primary Evap activation time as 93:33:30; and we're standing by for the AGS abort constants. Over. Or...

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Roger...

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke
a16_0942144.text: ...let's do the steerable first and get - and get you the downlink off the E-memory dump. Over.

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Okay. We're standing by for the steerable.

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Okay, PM, Secondary, Primary, Voice...

a16_0942144.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942144.text: Casper, this is Houston. Will you go Auto?

a16_0942144.speaker: Mattingly (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: You're Auto.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: What have we got there, Charlie?

a16_0942144.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Bringing up the steerable.

a16_0942144.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0942144.text: Okay. You want me to help you?

a16_0942824.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942824.text: Casper, this is Houston. How do you read? [Pause.]

a16_0942824.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942824.text: Roger, Casper. I have a PIPA bias update for you. [Long pause.]

a16_0942824.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942824.text: Orion, this is Houston. We want you to go Low Bit Rate and then bring up the High Gain. [Pause.]

a16_0942824.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942824.text: Orion, this is Houston. The pitch should be 99 on the steerable. [Long pause.]

a16_0942824.speaker: Duke
a16_0942824.text: Okay, Houston. We got the aft Omni, I can't - when I move the yaw drive, the yaw indicator does not move on the steerable, and I do not hear any grinding noise. Over.

a16_0942824.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942824.text: Roger, I copy no response on the yaw drive.

a16_0942824.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942824.text: Roger. if you're ready, Charlie, I'll read you the AGS abort constants.

a16_0942824.speaker: Irwin
a16_0942824.text: Okay, 224 beginning: plus 60511, plus 29419, plus 60383, plus 00565, minus 32776, minus 54412. Over.

a16_0942824.speaker: Duke
a16_0942824.text: Rog. That's what I got - minus 54412.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. I can't seem to get the yaw out of the stowed position, minus 12 on the indicator, and I cannot hear it drive when I move this dial - just like the - in pitch I can hear it drive and the needle follows. Over.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, I - We read you, Charlie. We want you to go through a little procedure here to essentially get you back to a start position. We want you to go to Slew on the S-Band. Check both S-Band circuit breakers on 11 and 16. Select Pitch of minus 75 and Yaw of minus 12: wait 30 seconds and then go to an acquisition and we'll have some angles for you.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, that's where we are. [Long pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Casper, this is Houston. Go to Accept. And, Orion, the angles for your S-band are Pitch of 99 and Yaw of 16. [Pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: And, Casper, this is Houston. I have that PIPA bias for you whenever you're ready to copy. [Pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, on the PIPA bias: Address 1454, Data 03521; Address 1456, Data 76274. Over. [Pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, on the 1456, couldn't hear your readback, Ken. The data is 76274.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: And, Casper, this is Houston with a DAP load for you whenever you're ready. [Long pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Casper, this is Houston. We're finished with the computer.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, I'm in Block, and I'm standing by.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Orion, this is Houston. Will you select Down Voice Backup...

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Voice Backup. How do you read?

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Roger. We're reading you but still excessive noise down here.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. Was it as noisy on the other transmitter receiver and power amp?

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: I think it was about the same, Charlie.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, be advised - we went through the steerable Step 2 on Page 3-62, and the yaw still does not indicate that it's moving, and we cannot hear a grind. Though, with those angles, I get a - that I got of 99 and minus 12, I get a signal strength of greater than 3. I went Track Mode to Auto and UpLink - and when I went Track Mode to Auto, it sounded like the thing is setting up there just constantly oscillating and the - the pitch needle varies plus or minus 10. The signal strength stays pretty constant. In fact, no matter what position I select on the S-Band antenna, the signal strength stays up

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. Could we press on with the Aft Omni in - in this configuration? Over.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. Can you get an E-memory dump? We're ready for the E-memory dump.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, let's bypass that because we need high bit rate.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. You can't get high bit rate on the omni?

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Not until we get to the - 210 up.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. [Pause.] Okay, we'll bypass the UpLink and we'll go on and do the - the Ascent Battery checkout.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, we're ready for the battery checkout.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Okay. Is it okay to do the P52 without - Okay to do the P52 as soon as we get into darkness here? [Long pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Houston, can I do the P52 when I get into the darkness? Over.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Stand by. [Pause.] Okay, we're preparing a REFSMMAT for you now, John, that you'll have to put in manually. Then you'll be able to proceed.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Where's the G&C Checklist? Oh man! [Long pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Orion, we - we'd like you to go back to Slew and place the antenna at the Stow position, minus 75 and minus 12 and just leave it there.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Tell them okay. We got it.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: And, Charlie; if you're ready to copy, I have this P27 update for the REFSMMAT and state vector for you.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, Hank. Just make sure that I get a break here about 94:49. Okay, go ahead with your PADs.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, this is at 95:55. Weight 39298, plus 0.49, plus 1.22.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, that's a good readback, I have your state vector for you when you're ready.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: And, Hank, Jim's still up on our loop.

a16_0943300.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0943300.text: Roger. He just went off, Ken.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay. Did you get my readback?

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: And we ought to orbit down here at eight miles. This is really neat.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Did you have anything else for me, Hank?

a16_0943300.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0943300.text: Roger; I had your P24 PAD for about 96:45. I think we've got time to get that in.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Yes, sir; let's go ahead. I'm ready.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, Hank. I thought 16-3 was to be used only for high altitude. That's kind of a large crater, isn't it?

a16_0943300.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0943300.text: Stand by, and I'll check it.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Maybe that's the only one that's in the track. Okay, let me read it back to you, and just verify that later. 096:43:59, 96:45:37.0, 96:46:07, 96:46:29; roll, 015; pitch, 296; yaw, 000; north, 3 miles on 16-3.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Oh shit. I can't believe it.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay. And I'm going to go out the window here for just a minute. And I've got the VHF off so I can talk to you. If the LMs call me or something, you might give me a call.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: And, Orion. This is Houston. I have a Sep PAD whenever y'all are ready.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Orion, this is Houston with another procedure for the S-band.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Roger. We want you to open the S-Band Antenna circuit breaker on panel 11, wait 1 minute, and then try acquisition again.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: After 1 minute, you close the circuit breaker and try an acquisition.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, Houston. How do you - you load this state vector by a Verb 71, and then a 24 Enter, then enter the numbers, right?

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: ...state vector's the 24 [garble]. See - see, we've got a flashing 24.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Now when you do a 24, you're going to get it. The Verb 71 and then you've got 24 index, okay?

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Orion, this is Houston. Roger. You should enter it just as it's read up on the PAD.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, I'm coming up on the edge of the Kant Plateau now and, from down here, that looks like a real steep rise. That's very impressive. But there's nothing that's particularly significant about the topography or the texture, it just rises up.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Understand. Verb 71; then a 24 Enter; then a 01731 Enter; and so on.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: And all the surface here, Hank, has this striation effect to it. It's like we were looking at down there at - pictures of the Silver Spur and so forth. But this is on the horizontal surface. And it all has that same effect.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: 70161 Enter. Wait a minute. Have to take that back.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: I don't know how to do that.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, we'll go back and change that later. Start out [garble]. 73753 Enter.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: A reminder of a Verb 33 at the end of your entries.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Rog. Understand. We've got a hot mike down there.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Go ahead. What are you on, 1207?

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, Hank, we slipped by it. Coming up upside down and backwards almost vertical like this, I didn't get a very good hack at it, but I did get a - one look at it, and you can identify North and South Ray and all the features there, and got a look at that old Erastostenion [sic] Crater that's over to the southwest that shows beautiful lineaments in the photographs. And they aren't there visually from - from here. It looks like it has the same interior that all the rest of the things do. And I'll talk more about that later.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, that was a mistake on 701 - Okay, now let me see, that's...

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: It says delete. We got to check it. [Long pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, I'm ready to go to work.

a16_0943300.speaker: CapCom
a16_0943300.text: Did you get any photos in there?

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, Orion. This is Houston. We're looking at Page 1-26 in the G&N Dictionary to review the data.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Got just one. Just had one glance at it before it was occulted by the LM.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. Now, we got one that's wrong.

a16_0943300.speaker: CapCom
a16_0943300.text: Ken, did you get a Flight Plan change at a hundred hours and 20 minutes to charge Battery A?

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Yeah, we heard that, and we believe it's Number 13.

a16_0943300.speaker: CapCom
a16_0943300.text: Okay, I couldn't tell from here whether that'd gone up or not. That - At a hundred hours, 20 minutes, we'd like to add "Charge Battery A."

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay, charge Battery A at a hundred hours and 20 minutes, and I'm gonna go get my helmet and gloves on here. Then we'll do a little suit circuit integrity check. Got anything that we ought to do first?

a16_0943300.speaker: CapCom
a16_0943300.text: I'm just coming on. Did you happen to take a look at that docking latch? Okay, I've just been told that's all squared away. So I don't - don't know of anything that needs to be done now before you go ahead with the integrity check.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Enter. Okay. Enter. Noun 15. Noun - 5 Enter. There we go. Okay. Okay, let's review it.

a16_0943300.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0943300.text: Okay. I'm going to press into that.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Go ahead. No, John, you've got to Enter after every one of those. Verb 1 Noun 1 Enter. 1173 Enter. Noun 15 Enter.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay. Now Enter for each one - Okay, that one's correct. Now, Enter again. Okay, 12560. Okay, 22624, 66315, 75546, 71001, 47 - Enter. 47526.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Just a moment. That ain't what it says. 02044. Okay, mark that one. That's wrong.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, let's change it right now.

a16_0943300.speaker: Young
a16_0943300.text: Change data load component identifier; correct Data E. [Pause.] What's a component identifier?

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Okay, Orion. This is Houston. Line 11 should be 02044. Over.

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Yeah. I think it's Noun, John. Hey, Jim, on the checklist, when it says "Load component identifier," we got - 13 is wrong. What do we load in there?

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, load 70 - 70, 0164 Enter. Okay, the next one is 15...

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Hey, why don't you do the RCS pressurization [garble].

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Orion, this is Houston. We'd like you to close that circuit breaker and try an acquisition on the steerable. [Pause.]

a16_0943300.speaker: Duke
a16_0943300.text: Okay, Jim; the yaw is still not working.

a16_0943300.speaker: Irwin
a16_0943300.text: Understand. The yaw is still not working.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: You doing it over? All right, good idea.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Okay. Logic B has got to be Go.

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Houston. We're pressurizing RCS now.

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: Casper, Houston. For your information, the LM's about four or five minutes from hot fire.

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Orion. The RCS press looks good. [Pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0950006.text: Okay, I'm still on a tight dead band.

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: Okays. I was just giving you a warning, in case you wanted to bring your VHF up or whatever you need to do to talk to them.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Guidance Control, PGNS. Att/Translation to 4 Jets. Okay. Attitude Control, Three, to Pulse. Control Mode, Att Hold. ACA Jets, Disable. [Pause.] TTCA, Both Jets [garble]. [Pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Houston. Over. Houston, this is Orion. Over. [Pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Do you want us to open the ascent stage? No, don't do that! Goddamit!

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: That's all right, Charlie. What he said, wasn't it?

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: That ain't right. [Pause.] We're going to pump all the RCS into the APS tank, looks like to me.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Well, I just closed it again.

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Orion. The RCS pressure is creeping up on system A. [Pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Okay, it looks all right here, Jim.

a16_0950006.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Orion. I understand you're coming up on the hot fire check, and I think I'm supposed to go to a Wide Dead Band. Can I have about two minutes to complete my suit check?

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Roger. We're not going there yet. I'll tell you when.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0950006.text: Roger. We're not going there yet. I'll tell you when.

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Orion, this is Houston. Do you read that System A manifold pressure?

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: Casper, Houston. If you've got a sec there, I'd like to give you your sep PAD. Stand by; I'll wait until you get through with the check.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Roger. System A manifold pressure is 195.

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: Roger, Ken. I'll wait until you get through with your integrity check. Give me a call when you're through, please.

a16_0950006.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0950006.text: Okay, thank you. There's not much else I can do.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Did you check the other one, too?

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Orion. This is Houston. Looks like RCS manifold pressure on A is creeping up again. That's why we're holding you.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Okay, we - it does look like it's risen five pounds. [Pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Ken. Stay at Min Dead Band. We'll do a P52 here.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Ken. Stay at Min Dead Band. We'll do a P52 here.

a16_0950006.speaker: Mattingly (CM)
a16_0950006.text: Okay, I'm still in Min Dead Band. Thank you. [Long pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0950006.text: Okay, I'm still in Min Dead Band. Thank you.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: What [garble] in here, on this verb?

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Well, let's keep going. Verb 37; 52 Enter, Pro.

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Verb 32. Load 335 [garble] two - It should have been [garble] three.

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Orion, this is Houston. We want System A Ascent Feed, Open. And under no situation do we want the APS ullage pressure to exceed 180.

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Okay. [Pause.] Okay, we closed it. It's - ullage pressure is 170, now.

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: And, RCS is 180 and we're down to 85 percent.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: This is worst day sim I was ever in.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Okay, we can't do it P52, we got to do it [garble].

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Orion, this is Houston. You need the - that state vector in before you do the P52.

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Roger. We understand you already have it in.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Pro to the next display, right?

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: No, wait a minute. Let's do it again. Verb 21 Noun 01 Enter. 373 Enter. 32533 Enter. Pro. Okay, P53.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: We got to turn up the lights, Charlie,

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Enter? Go ahead, you are cleared to mark. 33195. Go ahead. [Pause.] 33197. [Garble.] [Long pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: 33 - Wait, let me recheck that. [Pause.] No, I don't know how you do that [garble]

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: You got to Enter it, Charlie. 33195. [Long pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: 16950, [garble]. [Pause.] 17007; and [pause] 17078 and... [Long pause.] What are you going to do? [Garble], Charlie.

a16_0950006.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0950006.text: Okay, Casper's completed with a suit circuit integrity check.

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: Real good, Ken. Can you copy a sep PAD now?

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Why don't you look at the [garble].

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: Roger. Noun 33, 096:13:31.00. And your attitude is good except pitch is 105.

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Orion, this is Houston. Will you check the Rendezvous Radar Operate circuit breakers on Panel 11?

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Roger. We copied that you said they were open, John. [Pause.]

a16_0950006.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0950006.text: Okay, I copy. Noun 33, 096:13:31.00. The attitude: 000, 105, and 000.

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: Good readback, Ken. And in regard to that question you had about 16-3, your present groundtrack is about 15,000 feet south of the preplanned, and that puts 16-1 outside the acceptable limits; 16-3 is closer to the landing site, and they would like for you to go ahead and use that.

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin
a16_0950006.text: Okay, the Rendezvous Radar Operate Heater should be Closed at this time.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Okay, we're at Close in Standby and Open - in Operate.

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Okay, the Rendezvous Radar Operate Heater is Closed.

a16_0950006.speaker: CapCom
a16_0950006.text: And I guess the message is there, Ken, just shoot the center.

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: It's just one [garble]. But if you don't see it, we'll go to two.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: Okay. I sure don't - sure don't see it.

a16_0950006.speaker: Young
a16_0950006.text: [Garble] all I see is the rendezvous radar. It's just stowed right there. Can we unstow the rendezvous radar?

a16_0950006.speaker: Duke
a16_0950006.text: Hey, Jim. We got the rendezvous radar in detent two. Can we slew it out of the way or can we select another star?

a16_0950006.speaker: Irwin

a16_0954500.text: That takes awhile. See? Good, we got it.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Pro. Okay, let's look at P00 now.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, we fixed it. Okay, what we need to do is get Ken's - state vector.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Well, Ken's state vector is the same as ours, Charlie.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: That's why that's an - I knew that's what it was. What is this pressure you've got to keep lower than, Charlie? Explain that to me.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, I'm back in tunnel vent and I'm gonna bring my roll engines on, and you're clear to check your relief valve.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Hey, I'll read it to you, Charlie.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Regulator check. Here we go. Okay, starting with cabin repress.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Cabin Repress valve to Manual. Verify flow, then Auto.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Verify overhead cabin dump valve to Auto.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Circuit Breaker 16, ECS, Cabin Repress to open.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Press Reg A and B to Egress.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Forward Cabin Dump Valve, Open, then Auto at 4½.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: No, I'll get it. Okay, here we go. And it's going down.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Auto at 4½. Suit Circuit Relief to Open.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Verify suit pressure at 4½, then Close.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Close. Press Reg A to Cabin. Verify suit pressure...

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, Press Reg A's coming to Cabin.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Right. Then it says, Press Reg B to - Press Reg A to Egress.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Suit Circuit Relief, Open. Suit pressure goes to 4½.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Verify suit pressure rises, 4.6 to 5. It is.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. Suit Circuit Relief to Auto.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Cabin Gas Return to Auto. Go ahead.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. We don't get any flow when we do that.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: I got - have I got my hoses right?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah, you got your hoses right. This thing is leaking like a sieve.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, Orion. I'm going to maneuver to the undocking attitude.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, John. What's next? Do the rate gyro check for me.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Can't do it while he's maneuvering.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Man, look at that Moon. We're going to have to get a rag to wipe this thing off with.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, just a minute. This thing, I can't get - keep - stay rolled up.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: There we go. Here you go, Charlie.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Just a minute. Okay, give it to me.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: We don't unsuit until after undocking?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Can you get the tape out for me, John? I can't get this thing to stay in down here.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: We were on Down Voice Backup that whole time?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Oh, boy is right. I had a couple of dadgummits. Okay, John. Let's go. We got some stuff to do here before undocking. Attitude Monitor, LMP, to PGNS. It is. Rendezvous Radar Mode to Slew.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Attitude Control, three, to Mode Control.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Balance Couple - Okay, Rate/Error Monitor, Landing Radar/Computer.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, Attitude Monitor, PGNS. Guidance Control, PGNS. Okay?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, my monitor. Okay, I got to mount the camera. Don't believe we're going to be able to see anything, though.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah, well, don't worry about that.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: All fogged up. How about turning the window heater on? Want to try a window heater?

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Want to try yours for a second?

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: You don't want to leave it on too long, Charlie. So don't forget.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. Okay, I'm going to open System B, so we'll have two jets, two -

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, Charlie. Okay, Ken. Are you in undocking attitude now?

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, Ken. Give me a Verb 06 Noun 20 on my mark.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Tell him to start over again.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. Copy four balls 4, 105.56 three balls 45.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: How much fuel can we transfer into the ascent tanks before it becomes too full to fly?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Well, it's the pressure I think that - that they're worried about - on the ascent tanks.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. And let me make a small trim maneuver. Looks like it should be less than a half degree, unless you'd like to just leave it alone. Either way.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, let's leave it as is.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, Charlie. The tape is going back in.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Well, I never did get to use it, but that's okay. Go ahead.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. What el - what else we got to check here?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Wait a minute, wait a minute. Okay, go ahead.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah. What's my f-stop for the 16?

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Be easy to find. There's LM3/DAC/10/CEN [sic] - ULC.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Mount Timeline Book. It's time. Okay, checklist [garble] check attitude. Verb - Verb 48 Enter. 21 Enter. 22012 Enter. Pro. We got the right weight, huh?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah. What's the DAC should be - I mean, there's Hasselblad/ DC/60/HEX-A, (f/11, 250, focus).

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. Configure circuit breakers per unlocking chart, [garble]...

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. Go ahead, and I'll get the camera out.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Nothing like a helmet full of water.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Here's your [garble], Charlie. Wait a minute. Let me check to be sure.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Charlie, I'm going to pull it open. I don't think we're supposed to leave them run too long.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah, it's working. Please close it. Then, up in the - you can just let it close - just a few more minutes, it'll be fine. Okay, why don't you open yours?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: John, can you see - is my thing leaking right now?

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: I can't tell, Charlie. Doesn't look like it. Is it leaking?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: My whole helmet's full of water. I mean my whole comm carrier. My hair is soaked.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Well, it leaks every time you put your - your thing up against it, that's for sure.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah. Every time you put it up against there, it leaks.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah. That makes it squirt out.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: You never had that happen to you before?

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: It never bothered you in one g.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah. Never bothered me in one g.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, Ken. How much to undocking?

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. It's gonna undock at 96:13 even?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: We'll stow the Activation Checklist - Oh, I can't. Harnesses are too tight. Do that later.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Are we through with the undocking - through the activation books, Charlie? I didn't do the rate gyro test.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, let's go through this little one.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Plus or minus 5 - 25 over there? No, that - that one.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okays it's got it. Let's see, are you hit - does your mike hit your valve? Let me see. Turn around towards me.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: When it does, I get squirted.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Yeah. I had to really be careful.

a16_0954500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: All we need to do is call P47.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: ... P47. Okay, you can close my window heater - open my window heater. It's clear now. Beautiful. Is yours closed, John?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. It'll clear it off in a little bit. Takes about ten minutes or so.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: John, I'm going to have to pull this water bag out of here, I think.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, can you read me on Vox, Orion?

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Orion, do you read on Vox?

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. We're inside of a minute.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Roger. We got P47 coming up.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, if you're on Vox, you're cutting out pretty badly, too. Thirty seconds.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, coming up. Give you a countdown for the release; 5, 4, 3, 2, 1...

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: We didn't go very far. (Laughter) Okay. We'll let it sit here for a second. Okay, we're going to back off, now.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Didn't get anything out of it.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Right on time to the second. This thing is a dream.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, John. P00. I got a - I give you Verb 60.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: I see you rolling, or yawing, as you guys do it. I see one, two, ought to see four [garble]. Haven't seen them yet.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, you can close - Okay. How's your window looking, John?

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, beautiful. Okay, camera's coming on.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: I can see three [garble] loud and clear. And looks like that one panel up there that we were watching shred is the only one that I see that is shredded. The rest of it's all intact.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Okay. Great, Ken. Man, it's great! Boy, when we fire the RCS, it really shakes the whole stack.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Hey, you're beautiful, babe! You're just beautiful !

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: Yes, indeed. You sure look good.

a16_0954500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0954500.text: Okay, all your booms are in.

a16_0954500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0954500.text: I see full view. You've got three [garble] down. Your [garble] valve's clean [garble] clean [garble] still hanging on. What more can you ask for?

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0961554.text: You can - you can see your RCS spitting at us.

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Yeah, yours is doing the same.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, Charlie. Helmet and gloves off.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Have we got Houston, yet? We ought to have them right now.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Not yet.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, let's go through this sequence.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, I got enough pictures here.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Yeah.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: That's ten.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Boy, Ken, you look great!

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Well...

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0961554.text: You really got a pretty spacecraft!

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Yours is a [garble] pretty one, too.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, John. Helmets - and cameras to off, VHF Antenna is Forward...

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0961554.text: It'll look even better without your [garble] peeking down underneath.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Sequence camera. Okay, suit gas diverter. Okay, let's get helmets and gloves off.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Orion, this is Houston. How do you read?

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Roger. Five by, Jim, and we're sailing free.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Roger. [Pause.]

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Tell him to stan - stand by one.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, Jim. It was a little rushed, but we got it done. The only thing that's bad is that I got a pack full of orange juice.

a16_0961554.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0961554.text: Casper, Houston. How do you read?

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0961554.text: Loud and clear, and let me clean up some things, Hank, and I'll be with you in just a minute.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Okay, we copy, and we'd like you to go through another procedure here to get the S-Band locked up if you're - ready to make - take a few notes? [Pause.]

a16_0961554.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0961554.text: Okay.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Stand by one, Jim.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, we're on hot mike still, John. [Long pause.]

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: He told us to go ahead.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, Jim; go ahead.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Roger. We wanted to - you to put the steerable at Pitch, minus 75, and Yaw at minus 12. In other words, the stowed position. Go Track Mode, Slew, wait 30 seconds, and then go Pitch of plus 63, Yaw of minus 32, and antenna S-Band to Slew and proceed with normal acquisition. Over.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: O - Okay we copy. [Pause.]

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: And, Orion, this is Houston. We're...

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Hey, Ken.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Hey, Ken.

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Go ahead, Orion.

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0961554.text: Go ahead, Orion.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, look up over my - our right side and look at that antenna, the - the steerable, and see how it - it's moving. I'm going to move it in pitch, then in yaw. Over.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, look up over my - our right side and look at that antenna, the - the steerable, and see how it - it's moving. I'm going to move it in pitch, then in yaw. Over.

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Okay. On your right side. Okay, I 'got it, and it's moving in - looks like a combination now. It's moving, though; it's oscillating at this time.

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0961554.text: Okay, on your right side. Okay: I got it, and it's moving in - It looks like a combination now. It's moving though. It's oscillating at this time.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: And, Orion, this is Houston. We'd like to...

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, it should be stable

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, it should be stable

a16_0961554.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0961554.text: Now it's steady.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: ...find out what your RCS configuration is at the present time.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, Jim, we have got...

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: System A and B are Open, Crossfeed is Closed, and the Ascent Feed's been terminated.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Roger; we'd like you to use System A just as long as possible. Over.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, System A is - System A is - is now Open, Crossfeed is Open, and System B is Closed.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: And, Orion, have you loaded the AGS abort constants yet?

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Negative. We don't have...

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: That's negative. Over.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Okay, understand negative.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: We don't have the AGS up yet, Jim.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Okay, understand negative.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: That's affirmative.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Roger; because when you do load those constants, we want you to load nominal values from the data card.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Stabilization Control, Engine Arm, Closed.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, we're going ahead with the DPS throttle check, Jim.

a16_0961554.speaker: Irwin
a16_0961554.text: Okay, and, if this S-band procedure doesn't work for us, we're going to ask you to maneuver to an FDAI attitude, where the - the yaw angle will not have to change and we'll see if we can lock up in that attitude.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, you do that while I get the...

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Roger. Understand.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, DPS throttle check.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0961554.text: What you got to do, Charlie - You are all wet. Here, get the thing back away from you.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: I got - I got it now. [Pause.]

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Now, give - why don't you get me - get me a towel here.

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Okay. Charlie?

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Engine Arm to close.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, Houston. Houston, how do you read on the steerable?

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Give the Engine Arm.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Do what?

a16_0961554.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Engine Arm breaker - there you go.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0961554.text: Got it.

a16_0961554.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0961554.text: Okay, Houston, back on the aft omni. How do you read?

a16_0963957.text: Roger.

a16_0963957.text: The things I'm looking at now are really not that far from the terminator.

a16_0963957.text: Okay, I was wrong on that. I got it now, 0102.6.

a16_0963957.text: Okay...

a16_0963957.text: Okay, that's a good readback, and I have T2 and T3 for you.

a16_0963957.text: Yeah.

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: What did it look like?

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: It's okay.

a16_0963957.speaker: Irwin
a16_0963957.text: Orion, we'll get back to you on the landing radar.

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0963957.text: Roger. [Pause.]

a16_0963957.speaker: Irwin
a16_0963957.text: And, Orion...

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0963957.text: You can see the data.

a16_0963957.speaker: Irwin
a16_0963957.text: ...Houston, just a reminder on - to load 405 and 406 to plus zero. [Pause.]

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0963957.text: Rog.

a16_0963957.speaker: Irwin
a16_0963957.text: And we're ready for Hi bit rate. [Pause.]

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0963957.text: Okay, you have it.

a16_0963957.speaker: Irwin
a16_0963957.text: Roger.

a16_0963957.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0963957.text: Orion, Casper. Are you ready for rendezvous radar VHF range check?

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0963957.text: Okay, I'm going to terminate the landing radar test, if that's okay with y'all.

a16_0963957.speaker: Irwin
a16_0963957.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Okay, Verb 47 Enter.

a16_0963957.speaker: Mattingly (CM Comm)
a16_0963957.text: Orion, Casper. Are you ready for a landing radar VHF [garble].

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Okay. Verb 25.

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0963957.text: That's negative; Houston wants them to stay locked on right now.

a16_0963957.speaker: Mattingly (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Roger.

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Wait a minute, John. Turn back.

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Okay, excuse me, Charlie.

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Okay. Got to go Hi, Enter, Pro. Did you wipe out my helmet for me?

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Yeah, I did.

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Okay, thank you.

a16_0963957.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Are we still locked up?

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Yeah.

a16_0963957.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0963957.text: Good signal strength.

a16_0964955.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0964955.text: Casper, Houston. If you'll give us Accept, we'll up-link your state vector and target load.

a16_0964955.speaker: Irwin
a16_0964955.text: Okay, ignition at 097:40:17.16; Noun 81s, plus 0068.1, minus all zeros, minus 0058.0. Over. [Pause.]

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0964955.text: Rog, copy. 097:40:17.16, plus 0068.1, minus all balls, minus 0058.0.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, let's - let's bypass the rendezvous radar. I guess we've got to...

a16_0964955.speaker: Irwin
a16_0964955.text: Roger; we're standing by, John. [Long pause.]

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, Pro. Okay, Pro. Okay, AOT Lamp, close.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Forward detent. Okay. Nope. Enter, yeah. Okay, load 226.

a16_0964955.speaker: Irwin
a16_0964955.text: Okay, Charlie, will you - In 404, will you put minus 12345? [Pause.]

a16_0964955.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0964955.text: Give me about 30 seconds, Hank, and I'll give you a call.

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, Houston, when we do this attitude maneuver for the P52, we're going to lose high gain.

a16_0964955.speaker: Irwin
a16_0964955.text: I think we're all prepared for it.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, you want to close your - your window shade up there?

a16_0964955.speaker: Irwin
a16_0964955.text: Okay, you can go ahead and maneuver, John...

a16_0964955.speaker: Irwin
a16_0964955.text: ... and we want you to use the RCS system A.

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0964955.text: Okay. [Pause.] Okay, we're using System A. [Long pause.]

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Want to put these back up, John? [garble] there.

a16_0964955.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0964955.text: Roger. Circ, SPS/G&N; 39293; plus 0.49, plus 1.22; 097:40:17.16; plus 0068.1, minus all zips, minus 0058.0; 000, 142, 358; Noun 44, 0067.4, plus 0051.6; 0089.5, 0:05, 0078.0. The rest of the PAD is NA. Set stars, Sirius, Rigel; 131, 071, 014. Two jets, 16 seconds; quads Bravo and Delta. End of PAD, and the computer is yours.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Right over there on your panel.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: We ain't got a steerable antenna.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, Houston, we have you on the aft omni. [Long pause.]

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Probably the - may be the landing radar. You see anything?

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Why, should I see the landing radar?

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: I don't know. Okay, it says we're there. We're Spica. Yeah.

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: There's something right there. It's - it's the rendezvous radar antenna.

a16_0964955.speaker: Irwin
a16_0964955.text: Orion, this is Houston. Go Lo bit rate.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, let's go. Push your breakers in.

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, I'll give it 30 seconds, Charlie.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, go to Slew, Down. Going out of the way?

a16_0964955.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0964955.text: Okay. Thank you very much, Hank. I'll read it back to you in just a second. Okay, and circ, SPS/G&N; 39293; plus 0.49, plus 1.22; 097:40:17.16; plus 0068.1, all zips, minus 0058.0; 000, 142, 358; 0067.4, plus 0051.6; 0089.5, 0:05, 0078.0. Sirius and Rigel; 131, 071, 014. Two jets, 16 seconds; quads Bravo and Delta. Over.

a16_0964955.speaker: Mattingly (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Let me shoot a Slew. The AOT is not moving?

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: The AOT moves. The thing that I'm looking at ain't moving.

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: There you go. Now you got it. You got it. Whoa.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, good. I was slewing the wrong way.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay. Now, turn the lights off. You see a star?

a16_0964955.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0964955.text: Good readback, Ken, and I'll give you the abort PADs after you do your P52.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, you're in Verb 76. There you go, and you're clear to mark.

a16_0964955.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0964955.text: Okay. Yeah, let's get to work on these first. Thank you.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Two, three. Okay, now you go to the other axis, so that's four. Okay, that was a reject.

a16_0964955.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0964955.text: Hank, it looks like we made a little discrepancy here in the way it is now. It shows we crossed out the Verb 48 at 97:15 to get us a 10101 because we were all ready there, I thought. And that doesn't look like the case. I guess we're gonna catch it up here after the burn. It is probably okay in its present form? Is that correct?

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: ...Enter; 233 Enter; Pro. Okay, Pro. Hey, that thing really takes off, doesn't it? [Laughter]

a16_0964955.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0964955.text: That's affirmative. We went to 10102 back at 96:34, and we crossed out the one at 97:15, and we figured that same DAP, and it would hold you through the burn, and then we'll go to the new DAP after the burn.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Huh? Man, look at that - Oh, there's old Casper out there. Isn't he pretty?

a16_0964955.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0964955.text: The reason is being - is because we do have 509 in there. We can't do another DAP with it running.

a16_0964955.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0964955.text: Roger. Understand that. Thank you, sir.

a16_0964955.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0964955.text: Just want to make sure with all the changes around in this 509 that we hadn't overlooked one.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, Enter, Pro, Go ahead. You got a Verb 76.

a16_0964955.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Oh, yeah. No doubt about it. See the whole bloody constellation.

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Okay, that was The Y, right?

a16_0964955.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0964955.text: Pro, lights up. Super, John. Okay, minus 00005, Pro. Look at that.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Houston. The torquing angles: minus 0.060, plus 0.139, minus 0.018. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Orion, we cannot read you. Will you go Downvoice Backup? [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, you have Down Voice Backup. And our angles were - Noun 93s were minus 060, plus 139, minus 018, and we Pro'd at 96:58:40.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we can Enter on that.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Orion, go Aft Omni.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Aft Omni. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: I got Aft Omni. Okay, go to closed and AOT Lamp open, John. Okay. And I think we're getting a little close for Ken to do his - do this rendezvous...

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, may - perhaps we can read the torquing angles, if you want to give them again. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay. Torquing angles are minus 0.060, plus 0.139, minus 0.018 at 96:58:40.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Star angle difference was minus four balls five. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: They've already got the up-link in.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we ought to get the radar check out of the way.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Well, I think Ken is getting ready for a burn at 90 - in 40 minutes. Ask him if he's ready and can support that.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: We don't need it.

a16_0965812.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0965812.text: Houston, what do you say we pass the GDC Align for the COAS calibration maneuver and get back on the time line?

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we copied your Noun 05, but we did not get the torquing angles. I hope y'all have written them down. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Roger. Minus 0.060, plus 0.139, minus 0.018. Over.

a16_0965812.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0965812.text: That's a good plan, Ken. We concur.

a16_0965812.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0965812.text: Okay. Thank you.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, that looks good. That's great.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Orion, this is Houston. We'd like to get Hi Bit Rate again and some good voice. We'd like you to go back to that attitude which we gave you of pitch of 053 and set in the steerable angles of Pitch plus 26 and Yaw minus 12.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we're en route.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: And just delay the landing radar test until we get some good data.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: I guess on that landing radar - with the circuit breaker in - probably working off the ground - maybe not. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Could be.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Go Forward Omni, Orion. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Jim, you have Forward Omni. How do you read?

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Ought to get there in a hurry.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Yeah. You want me to do a Verb 49?

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: No, we're almost there. What a [garble].

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Jim, how do you read Forward Omni? Over.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Orion, let's go back to Lo bit rate until we get the steerable. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we're Lo bit rate. How do you read now? 053, John.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we're there.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Jim, we have you now on the steerable. How do you read? Over.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Oh, I read you loud and clear. You sound beautiful.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, the P52 went super. Our torquing angles were minus 0.060, plus 0.139, minus 0.018. We torqued at 96:58:40. Over.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Roger; copied. On torquing angles, minus 0.060, plus 0.139, and minus 0 - 0.018 at 96:58:40.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: That's Rog.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: And you can go Normal voice.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: And the AGS checkout has gone well. Okay. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: The only thing we haven't done is Rendezvous Radar checkout and we'll get to that soon as Ken gets through with his burn.

a16_0965812.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0965812.text: All set.

a16_0965812.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0965812.text: Okay. Echo, 098:47 all zips; Foxtrot, plus 0102.3, all zips, minus 0050.0; Golf, 099:35 all zips; Hotel, 101:22:15.00; India, 098:35:04.68; Juliet, 101:22:15.00; Kilo 103:21 all zips; Lima, 098:59:29.03; Mike, 105:19:45.00; November, 100:42:42.86. End of PAD.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: All right, fine.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we're going now. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Landing Radar, in.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, CB(11), PGNS Landing Radar, closed.

a16_0965812.text: Closed.

a16_0965812.text: Go.

a16_0965812.text: 60 to 95. Okay, that's a little high.

a16_0965812.text: It's been running, Charlie. I've already done it three times. Go.

a16_0965812.text: Crosspointer, Hi Mult.

a16_0965812.text: Hi Mult.

a16_0965812.text: Mode Select, Landing Radar.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Landing Radar.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: H/H-dot.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: H/H-dot.
