a16_0965812.text: Landing Antenna to Auto.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Landing Antenna to Auto.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay. Radar Test, Landing.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Radar Test to Landing.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Power signal is out. Going out, test monitor - okay, that's on the tapemeter.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, it's up and left like it's supposed to be.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, John, when you get to the Noun 66...

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Do you reckon it could...

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: ...67 values, we want you to read us the tapemeter values of H and H-dot. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: It's right on. It was the...

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, it's right on, Houston. It's 8000 and 480 off the H-dot. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: It was locked on at the ground, I bet you.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Roger; we copy. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Yeah. Pro, Charlie. Waits I'll have to change this - wait until this one changes.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: See, there it goes. Okay now, Pro.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, minus 495, plus 1860, plus 1331.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, minus 495, plus 1860, plus 1331, right on, and the tapemeter is up and left and it's reading 8000 at 480. I think it was locked on the ground or something when we came over that low pass, due to our communications angle. That may be wrong, but that's - you know - it was sure acting funny.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Right on.

a16_0965812.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0965812.text: That was a super reading, Hank. I'll read back. Echo, 098:47:0.00; plus 0102.3, all zips, minus 0050.0; Golf, 099:35 all zips; Hotel, 101:22:15.00; India, 098:35:04.68; 101:22:15.00; Kilo, 103:21 all zips; Lima, 098:59:29.03; 105:19:45.00; 100:42:42.86. Over.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, it's looking good to us now.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we've got 3.2 on the Altitude Transmitter and 345 on the Velocity Transmitter; make that 355.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, let's terminate this test.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Verb 34.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we copy.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Hey, Jim, on those drink bags, I tell you, it's pretty hard to see things when you've got a helmet full of orange juice in zero gravity, it's something with that orange juice.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Landing Radar to...

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Well, you've got to drink fast.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: You really do. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Tell me what to do there, Charlie.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay. Eleven - Landing Radar breaker, open.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0965812.text: Good readback, Ken.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we're all set.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: When do we get the 210 up, Jim? [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, acquisition on your next rev. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, pitch down just a little bit. We're losing it. Okay, it's coming great - coming back in. Why don't you go to Att Hold when you get there. Okay?

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: All right, I will, Charlie. I never thought about that. What a can of worms.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Comm can really kill you, can't it?

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Wipe you right out.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, Verb 77. We've got good signal strength.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Hey, Jim, we had to turn on our window heaters for about ten minutes per side to clear up the windows - right aft - right before undocking.

a16_0965812.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0965812.text: And, Casper, for your information, PIPAs and AGS look good.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Roger; we copy. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0965812.text: All righty.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Shoot me another slug - slug of water.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: (Laughter)

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: We've been using the - we've been using the LCG pump to keep cool in here, and it's really neat.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: We copy.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: We've been needing something to keep cool, I'll tell you.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Yeah, we understand completely. [Long pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Jim, your uplink voice is just beautiful in every antenna we got. Over.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, that's a good data point. Unfortunately, the downlink is very, very noisy.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, I wonder what happened. On the check - the comm checks we did at 55 hours, of course, it was closer, but it was real good then, I thought. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: what do we need to do here, Charlie?

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Well, we're going to copy and load gyros -

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: No, scrub those things.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Yeah, okay. We'll scrub this.

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: Okay, we understand it's just a completely different situation, Charlie. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: If you'll let me get this camera...

a16_0965812.speaker: Irwin
a16_0965812.text: But your voice is just crystal clear right now. [Pause.]

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0965812.text: Roger.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, John, I'm going to set - see what I have to set this thing at. Turn the page a little bit. I think it's 500.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: John, I think I ought to take this drink bag out of my suit so I won't have a face full of water.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: It'll probably all settle out when I'm...

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: When you get on the Moon.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: ...when I get on the Moon and once we get some g on us.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Yeah.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: What do you think?

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Yeah, I think you're right.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Take it out?

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Well, unless it's really - if it's really not bothering you too bad, leave it in there and drink from it.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Well, I'll tell you what. I'll be very careful. Wonder if I could cut that microphone off.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: No, I wouldn't do it, but why don't you shape it in like this, pull it in like this. There you go. Then if - then if you pull it up.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, that's - that's great.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: See?

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Yeah, okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay, let me see a pencil and a - give me those gyro torquing numbers, John.

a16_0965812.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0965812.text: Orion, Casper.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Which ones, Charlie?

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: On the time line where we - the P52 you just did. Back over here.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Okay.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: [Garble] 96:59.

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Yeah.

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: And the previous torque was...

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: Minus 060?

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: No, wait a minute. When did we do the dock P52?

a16_0965812.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: What are you worried about that for?

a16_0965812.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0965812.text: I want to calculate these gyro drift comps. Give me your checklist out of your purse - Wait a minute.

a16_0965812.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0965812.text: Orion, Casper. Orion, Casper.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That's the activation one, Charlie.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Go ahead.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0971246.text: Roger. I take it we've deleted the rendezvous radar check. Is that good? I'm asking the question. Did we delete the...

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Give me yours. I'll put it up for you.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Roger. It looks like you'll be coming in about 10,000 feet [3,000 metres] high at PDI, John, which will be about 3 to 4 seconds of hover time, and you'll be 17,000 feet [5,000 metres]...

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Understand. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: ...south.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, does that mean that we're going to be - at pitchover, we'll be steering from south to north?

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: That's affirmative.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, so at pitchover, we'll be - you'll be targeting us right into the target, but we'll be steering from south to north. Is that based on Ken's tracking?

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: No, that's not - Negative on that one.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: How did he get...

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: But you'll probably be coming straight in by the time you get down to pitchover.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, thank you. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: How did he do on the landmark tracking? Ask him.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: How did landmark tracking turn out ?

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Stand by. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: We didn't even use it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0971246.text: Casper, a preliminary look at your tracking data looks real good.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, the landmark tracking looked very good, John.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Good. I hope it is.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Orion, will you give us your ED Bat read-out, please? [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: The same as always, 37 volts.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Very good. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Jim, is Guidance going to have any gyro drift for us ?

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Stand by. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, no update on that. And it looks like your - the attitude for PDI is very close to the one that we'd like for the s - steerable, so we'll try that when you come around at AOS.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: And, Jim, on this P52. It - that radar was - has drifted up into the field of view, but it's no sweat just moving it down in slew.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we copy. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: And one other thing that - when we put those state vectors in there, I guess we didn't have any - the LM vector in there and my Computer Activity light stayed on all the time. I finally figured out what it was and did a Verb 66 and got rid of it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we concur.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: I think - I think that's what it was.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Everybody's nodding their head down here - affirmative. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: How you staying down there so good?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Charlie, I'm sitting in one g now.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You are?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Why?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Because I'm right on the floor.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: This Velcro just doesn't work. I just come right up off it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Well, John, it was heck (laughter) for a while, but I think we made it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: No.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Can we fly down...

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Houston, 16 - what appears to be the problem with System A. Is it a reg[ulator] problem or what?

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Yes, that's affirmative, Charlie, a reg problem.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, will we have a - If we use up fuel - just System A for descent, is what you want us to do.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Stand by. We'll give you an RCS configuration for PDI when y'all come around the corner.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Well, we'll be back. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: And I'd like somebody to think about this high APS pressure we have during the lunar stay. Over.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we're looking at that one too, John. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: He doesn't know the difference between you and me. He keeps calling me you and you me.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I know it. That's going to bite us right there.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That APS pressure? Yeah, we can't do that, can we? Oh, no, you stay for 3 days...

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we are noticing an increase in the RCS pressure there, but we have enough ullage volume now to get the - all the propellant out.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Understand. Thank you. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That means you're going to let it go to the relief valve.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I guess so.

a16_0971246.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0971246.text: Casper, Houston. We have a Go for circ. And, as a little reminder there, don't forget to terminate the EMP after the burn.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0971246.text: Okay; the EMP will be terminated after the gimbal drive check. Is that affirmative?

a16_0971246.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0971246.text: That's affirmative.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0971246.text: All righty. Thank you, sir.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You want to apologize for our comments on hot mike during that hectic time period?

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Orion, this is Houston. Have you...

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Yes, If we were on hot mike...

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: ...ever noticed any change in your yaw meter? [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Jim, it's - stuck on minus 12.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, and go ahead, John. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: I think that if we're on hot mike when we're talking to each other, I want to apologize right now. It's probably pretty interesting. Probably not, if the comm was as bad as you said it was.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: It was good enough for us to understand you. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That's what I was afraid of (laughter).

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: We were afraid of that. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] these things.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Orion. If you see that reg pressure creeping up, you could do a small maneuver, which would help the situation.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Understand; we'll do that.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: We'll do a Verb 49 for the AGS cal attitude, Jim.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Okay. [Pause.] And, Orion, we're coming up on about two minutes to LOS. [Pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0971246.text: Casper, Houston. We're about two minutes from LOS.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You want to answer him, John?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Roger; two minutes to LOS. See you around for PDI. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Hank. Thank you, sir.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0971246.text: This is Apollo Control; 96 hours, 15 minutes. About 50 seconds now away from Acquisition Of Signal with Orion and Casper coming around from the backside of the Moon. Separately this time. Standing by for confirmation from the network controller that the tracking station does have data and downlink from the two spacecraft. There'll be some trouble shooting around this rev on the steerable antenna on Orion, and a further checkout of the discrepancy in regulator pressures on the Lunar Module Reaction Control System thrusters. We have AOS confirmation from [the] Network controller. Let's come up o

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Orion, this is Houston. For your information the burst disk pressure is 215 to 220 - the RCS.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Roger; understand.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Jim, is it both systems you see climbing?

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Just System A.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Just System A, right. [Long pause.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Let's load that, Charlie.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That, the AGS cal?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay...

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: What's the AGS cal attitude?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0971246.text: Hey, Jim, I saw the landing site as we passed over it. We're not going to have any trouble recognizing it from the rays. The rays stand out beautifully.

a16_0971246.speaker: Irwin
a16_0971246.text: Very good. Glad to hear it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0971246.text: This is Apollo Control. And both spacecraft have passed behind the Moon during the end of the 12th lunar orbit. During this past rather interesting frontside pass, several nagging problems have cropped up or have been carried over from the preceding revolution. One concern is the Landing Radar which, in its self-test mode, gave some spurious readouts, the readouts never agreeing with what the test should be. Later on in a repetition of the Landing Radar self-test, the numbers on the onboard display came out as they should. John Young speculated that perhaps because of the low altitude at the t

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Here we go.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Now, shall we do it?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Oh...

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Might as well.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Going P00 and Data [garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, go ahead.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Ken, how do you read? Over.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Loud and clear. How me?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Ken, do you read us on VHF? Over.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Yes, loud and clear.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You fixing to do the burn, right?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Sure am.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, when you finish the burn, we'd like to get a radar check [garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. I'll see what I can do.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] I know that sounds a little late, but we'd sure like to do it. We'll do a P76 after you finish your verb - and a Verb 83 and get a radar lock, if that'd be all right.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Let's see how much I have to do.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Here we go. Gosh! This thing take off.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Spares no effort.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It sure doesn't.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Now, we wait here about five minutes; it'll get the rates down so low I can do a Verb 76 and you can do the whole bit.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Look at the - See we got zero rates. Look at the - look what she pitch rate is, five degrees down.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Mine says the same thing. Okay, 540 read-out: hasn't changed. 541 read-out: that hasn't changed. 542 read-out: that hasn't changed. 544 read-out: hasn't changed. 545 read-out: it's good. 546 readout: good. It says go Attitude Hold, going to damp the rates, too, and Enter on that. Verb 60, a Verb 76, and Verb 1620.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I already got enough to do...

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] we go. Okay, 400, and I stopped the DET. [garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, I'm going to cycle the CWEA.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: All right, Charlie, why don't you cycle the CWEA. It had a Quad 1 light on when you did it. Remember we did that before once?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Quad 1 light? We had a Quad 1 light then?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: A red light - a red flag when you cycled it. It cycled all of them, as a matter of fact...

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Oh.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: ...It reset them all.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: What do you stay in here for? if they don't have the high gain, there won't be no reason - Well, maybe they'll get us on a 250-foot dish. I've lost my glove - No, there they are. Where's yours? You got your gloves somewhere?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Aren't you smart. What you going to do with your hat?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I don't know. What's it doing down there?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Well, you said wash it out, so I left it there.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Oh, okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Ain't the clearest in the world, but it's the clearest I could do, Charlie. Honest.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's terrible.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You want to try it yourself? Just doesn't come off.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Have you got another - another towel?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Have I got another towel? Yeah, there's a whole thing of them over here.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Let me wet this one down a little bit.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You start a clock backwards?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah, I ain't done nothing right since I got out of bed this morning.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we're getting - we're getting behind the time line probably - maybe.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: No, we aren't. We're okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, nothing we can do here, huh?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Can you give me a tissue - try it on the front.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That's better.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Here you go, Charlie.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, could you dry it a little bit for me, some more, while I copy the AGS cal numbers. We're through with this.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] marked. [Garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Here you go, Charlie. Where do you want to keep it?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Just velcro it back up here somewhere.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: We'll hit pretty hard.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, that's great, John.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] yaw [garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You know where to velcro it. How about right there?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Where?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: See there?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah, that'll be all right. No, I'll - I'll...

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Can you get it?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: ...knock into.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Wait a minute.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Wait a minute.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: How about right - there?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah, there's a piece.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, it won't go anywhere.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, here you go. AGS cal is complete.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's not gonna work.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: How's that pressure looking? It's up there, isn't it?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Charlie, this is fun, by golly. (Laughter) It's really - it's really - it's the worse sim I've ever been in.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's [garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's really bad, isn't it?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Hey, Orion?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You speak.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Go ahead, Ken.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I have an unstable yaw gimbal Number 2. It's just been oscillating and - oscillates in - yaw any time it gets excited.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Oh, boy.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You got any quick ideas?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: No, I sure don't,

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: What does your rules say, Ken?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: This thing says I have to have four servo loops to do the Circ [Burn].

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's what?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Every time I put Number 2 servo on, it's okay until I disturb it, and then it starts to oscillate. And you can feel the spacecraft shaking. It's really doing it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. You have to have four loops to do Circ, huh?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: That's what it says. It's unstable in all SCS modes on secondary servo [garble]. I can't believe it, but I'm watching it. Every time I select the secondary yaw gimbal, any excursion in the thumb-wheel causes it to go unstable.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Well, just hold what you got then.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Hey, Ken, why don't you just stop it and then start it again.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I've done that twice.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Oh, okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, let us get pointed at you and do a Verb 83.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, gang. I'm sure sorry about this, but that Number 2 servo is just oscillating like a wild man.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: And I tried it both in Manual and TVC and in the - in the - just with the thumb-wheel, and I get the same response. There could be a switch here somewhere but I - I swear I've checked them all, all I can. I guess I'll power them down.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Yep, and tell the ground when you go around.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Brother, what a way to start the day, huh?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Do you suppose there's any - Let me try terminating 509 and see if that would help maybe. No, it was in SCS. That shouldn't have any effect. I wonder if we got that relay stuck in there some way.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: The TVC enable relay?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah. I'm gonna try my gimbal drive check anyhow - in the G&N.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, John, I'll give you some needles. Follow those needles in AGS and point to him.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] no good in TVC either - in my gimbal drive check.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Which way do I go? I have to...

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I'm gonna back out here and power down.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yaw left, pitch down.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Okay, Ken, some - some you win and some you lose. I don't see any...

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: (Vox) 2's Off; Pitch 2's Off. Yaw 1's Off; Pitch 1's Off. Servos 1 and 2 are off.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Roger.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Going back to P00.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: No, good in - PGNS won't do it either?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That's why you don't leave the gimbals running for 20 minutes at a clip.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Bus Ties are coming Off; 1; 2's Off.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Just lost one gimbal motor, hasn't he?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Lost a servo loop in yaw.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Hey, Ken, is it both gimbals oscillate like that?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: No, the Number 2; and my burn rules say I got to have two sets of servo loops - two on each; got to have all four servo loops to go.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I think that's right, Ken.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I'm sorry, gang. I don't know what to do with the darn thing. It does it both when the CMC drives it and when we drive it. I've started it, restarted it, and it's just apparently really in the servo loop.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Instant sunrise.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Um-hmm.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I don't know; it's probably a very close race. Yeah [garble]. In fact, I guess the next thing we've got to do is make sure we don't hit.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I'll work on that.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Get a little roll in there, John. I guess - you're coming around okay, though. Roll doesn't really matter.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Oh, terrible!

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Where is it, Charlie?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: We've got to pitch down.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: When's AOS?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: We've got a little bit to go yet.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: There he is.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You got it?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: How...

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I show us at 0.8 miles and 0.8 of a foot per second.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You got a lookup?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: We got a visual on you.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You have?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Yes, sir.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: See him, John?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: What's that flashing?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: He's firing thrusters.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Oh.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: His beacon is on.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Which way am I pointing compared to you? I should be about 180 degrees away from you, huh?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: All we can...

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: There's no way to tell, T. K.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Oh, okay. I thought you could see more than that.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: All we see is your thruster firing.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, I've got my rendezvous lights on.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I just don't believe it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: We must have done something wrong.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Ken, we're going to lock up the radar on you.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay; I'm probably going to have to maneuver it so you can get a transponder. I doubt that you can get a - a lockup where I am now. Be with you in just a minute.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, we'll give her a go anyway. You're not very far away. We'll see.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Guidance Control, PGNS.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: We're there?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: AC Bus A, Rendezvous Radar, closed.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's closed. Thirty seconds, Charlie.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Slew for a manual lock on his [garble]. We're probably going to have to pitch up a little bit.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: We're only three degrees away from him.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: He just disappeared out the top of my window.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I got him.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Oh, yeah, there he is.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: No signal strength yet.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Ken, we must be out of your field of view.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. I don't want to call P20 because I'm not sure how it would interact with all this other stuff. So I'm gonna try another way of finding you. I'm gonna start a little pitch around. I'll pick you up and catch you later. ["I'm going to start a little pitch around and I think I'll pick you up." in LM transcript.]

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, turn on the tracking light, Charlie. [Garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I knew what the transformation error was.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Why isn't it moving? Oh, no.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You're in Auto Track.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: What time do we get AOS?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: About 98:08.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, I want to be in the right attitude when we get there.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: You got the sunrise?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Looks like it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Ken, we've had sunrise, and the Sun is behind us. I guess that's the best cue.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I got an unusually bright star. I bet that's you.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I'm almost pointing at you, if that's the case. I don't - That couldn't be. Must be a planet.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: We got our tracking light on.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You ought to be right in the sunrise.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, I guess you're a little ahead of me. You may get AOS first.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Is your transponder working?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, it self-checked okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I don't show anything on the AGC yet. Power's on. It should work.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Want to transfer some more of it to the RCS?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Well, we're right on the limit there [garble]. Firing it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You're looking down-Sun at me, right?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yep.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Say there, John, you're looking down-Sun at me?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: That's affirmative.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. I'm coming into the Sun, so I guess I must be coming closer to you.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Slew in Low, Right?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: We're pointed right at you, Ken.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I'm passing through the Sun right now.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That radar.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You ought to be looking right at us.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, what I'm looking at right now is the Sun.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: That ought to be us.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Seen my attitude yet?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: No, I can't - I can't see you at all. All I see is the light.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. If you have your tracking light on, you can turn it off before you burn it out. Maybe they can figure out some way to make it useful yet.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: There you go.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we got signal strength.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Roger. I show you locking up.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, go ahead and go to Auto Track, Charlie.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Down and to the - down and to the left, Charlie. Three degrees down and right in the middle.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we've got it. That's what the needles say.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: All right. All right, we've got it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: The tapemeter running [garble] we'll go to LGC, Verb 63.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Wait a minute [garble] all this.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] firing it, John.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we'll let's - let's do this and get out of here...

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I'm doing it.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. I got to wait until it locks up.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It's locked up.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It ain't.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Well, it ain't never going to with me firing these jets like this - and not looking at him.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Did it look like I was going over the top of you, John?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah, I believe so. Sure does.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah, you are.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Keep pitching, John.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Which way?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Up, he's going up.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: He's going up. He's going down underneath us.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That's right, that's right. He should go down underneath us.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, you got to Pro on that.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: It ain't locked up, John.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: He's off to the left.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: There was the rendezvous radar light.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Huh? Yeah, it's locked - he's locked up. Good enough.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: The light is not out. It is not locked up unless the light goes out.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, but I want to get the PDI attitude.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Well, let's go to PDI and forego this.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, we're terminating this rendezvous radar test, Ken. We're going to go to PDI attitude.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Let's do a Verb 49 to that one.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: No, it won't work until after you Pro at [garble] until you get a Verb...

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay; I don't have a visual on you yet, John.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Well, we're out in front of you and we're...

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You're out in front?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: That's affirmative. We're ahead of you. No, dadgummit.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I don't see how that could be.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, we're - we're upside down and the Sun is over our shoulder and we're looking back at you, and I promise that's the case.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I guess my nav system isn't very good.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, Ken, let's just forget this. I think you went down below us, and - we're going to PDI attitude, and why don't you go to your comm attitude.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay, what I'm trying to do is to keep from hitting you. I'd like to get a visual on you.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Why don't you just do a pitch - getting on the belly band and do a pitch around, John.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: [Garble] let's [garble] those breakers.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: He should be below us. We've passed undocking.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: I'll load this.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah, load the PDI attitude.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: My computer display shows that you're - that you're behind me.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Well, there for a while, Ken, we were locked up.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Can you put me against the sky or the ground, or did you?

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: You're against the sky about 5 degrees up - 6 degrees up.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Okay.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Hear the algorithm test?

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Yeah, that's what I'm doing.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I've got you. You were behind me.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: We are, huh?

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I think we're about a half [garble].

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: The Sun's coming over our shoulder, that's all I know.

a16_0971246.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0971246.text: Well, I guess behind is kind of relative.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0971246.text: I think you're right.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: The clock counts backwards. Well, there you go.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Let's go to PDI attitude then.

a16_0971246.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: That's where we're going.

a16_0971246.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0971246.text: Okay. Do you wait to Pro - we can Pro on this - do an auto maneuver.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Okay; let's start - let's go through this...

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: ...We don't have our helmets and gloves on, I guess there's no need to do that.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Okay, Stab/Control - You want to go through this?

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Okay. I'll put the Batts - Batts on.

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: I see why you taped yours down.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Put your attitude monitor on PGNS, John.

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Is that - is that the angle that you put them in, Charlie?

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Those angles, I can't load them - I don't know - Those things have nothing to do with the FDAI.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: It ain't going to work. You can't read off of that and load Noun 22 and have it go to that attitude.

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Yeah, you're right. Well, what was the old nominal PDI attitude? That's close enough.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Well, I'll tell you what. I'm going to turn off these ascent batteries. We don't need those. They ain't going to let us go.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Is it just - is it just an SCS where the servo loop is out?

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Yeah, it's in both systems. The G&N won't do it either, Charlie.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM comm)
a16_0980500.text: Hey, Ken, the G&N won't do the gimbal drive right either?

a16_0980500.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: No, sir. It goes unstable too.

a16_0980500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0980500.text: It's an honest-to-god instability in the servo loop.

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: What should we acquire them on here? Should be - we should he getting them now, Charlie. 98:10.

a16_0980500.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Well, the Earth's - ain't come up yet.

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Okay. Let me see the Timeline Book.

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Okay. Reset the window bars; AELD, close. Throttle Control to Auto and Cdr. That's Go. Throttle is Min.

a16_0980500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0980500.text: It turns out I got a switch out of place over here. I don't know whether something could come of that, but I'm pretty convinced that it's got to be a hardware-type problem.

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM comm)
a16_0980500.text: Yeah, I don't - I don't think a switch can do that to you.

a16_0980500.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: I don't think so. I'd like to find the switch right now

a16_0980500.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0980500.text: Did you try both sets of AC 1 and AC 2 on it?

a16_0980500.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0980500.text: Yeah, I got my high gain set up.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Orion, this is Houston. How do you read? [No answer.]

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Casper, Houston. How do you read?

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Understand. No Circ.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: That's affirmative. Presently, about a mile ahead of the LM. And I'd like to talk about a TVC servo loop problem.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Orion, this is Houston. How do you read? [No answer.]

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Okay, Ken. Go ahead.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Okay; yaw around to - yaw to zero.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: Okay, and - and break in and tell me as soon as you get the DS - get ready to dump the DSE, so you can take a look at what I'm talking about, and I'll leave the antenna Manual and Wide until you do. Okay; the text is that we came up to the burn time and I was going through the gimbal checks. Number 1 servo started normally, checked out. I switched to - clockwise on the THC to perform the secondary gimbal check and started them - they looked normal. I set the pitch trim normally, and I went to set the yaw trim; I'd just been checking that the trim lock [?] worked, and I got divergent oscillatio

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Yaw - yaw what?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Yaw right a little bit.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Why?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: So we can get a better - better lock on them.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Orion, this is Houston. How do you read? [Long pause.]

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0981049.text: [Garble] checked out. I switched to...

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Loud and clear.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0981049.text: ...[garble] the THC to perform the secondary gimbal check [garble] normal. I set the pitch trim normally, I went to set the yaw trim; and [garble] that the trim would not work and I got divergent oscillations on the yaw trim indicator, and you can feel them in the spacecraft. So, I switched to the...

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Hey, Ken. Go off VHF please. [Long pause.]

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0981049.text: ...the number...

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: All we got to do is...

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Huh?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Turn yours off, man.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Huh?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Turn it off over there.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Houston, Orion. Over.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Orion, this is Houston. We read you rather weak. How do you read us?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Roger; you're five by. The Command Module did not reach Circ. And we're standing by to - for y'alls' decision with him. Over.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Roger. Understand you standing by. We want you to stay with the omni and we'll be requesting high bit rate shortly.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Roger.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: And we're ready for high bit rate now.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Did you copy? No Circ.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: We copied, no Circ.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Okay; you have high bit rate.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: You hear that noise?

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Yeah, What is that noise? Huh?

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: I don't know either. Engine Arm, Off, Master Arm, Off, P00, Landing Radar is Off, Ascent Bats, Off.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: They are.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Roger. We copy...

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Propellant Quantity Monitor, Off.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: It is.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: We never turned it on. Audio to PTT.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: The [garble] was in fact running, but I don't think that could have had any effect when SCS was going.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: It is.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: ECS to Cabin mode.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: It is.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Helmet and gloves off, AGS to Att Hold.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: It is.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Align IMU, P52, same stars.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Roger. Could we get you to go to the AOS attitude, Ken, so we can dump the data?

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Okay, Ken's right out in front of us, maybe about a - 600 feet [180 metres], so we have a visual on him.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: Yes, sir. Will do.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: How about if I just give you the high gain from right here?

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0981049.text: How about if I just give you the high gain from right here?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke [Young in LM transcript](LM)
a16_0981049.text: So we have a visual on him.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Okay, if you think you can get it up.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Okay. We copy.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981049.text: What attitude do you want us to go to for bit.

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: I think you can stop it right now.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: I'm -

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Stay right where you are, John. You're coming - comm's fairly good.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Okay.

a16_0981049.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981049.text: Orion, will you confirm forward omni? [Pause.]

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0981049.text: Rog. That's what you have, forward omni.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0981049.text: Lunar Module Orion has been advised of the possibility of a wave-off for landing on this revolution. It seems that the circularization burn on the Command Module Casper was unsuccessful.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: Okay; I've got you a solid lock on the high gain.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Casper, Houston. We'd like to verify that...

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0981049.text: I prefer this attitude, Hank, because I can keep the LM in sight.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0981049.text: I prefer this attitude, Hank, because I can keep the LM in sight.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: [Garble] So I can keep the LM in sight.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Let's try that rendezvous radar lockup again, Charlie.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Casper, we'd like to verify that the - that the oscillations were on servo loop Number 2. Is that correct?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Okay.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: I don't understand why it didn't work. Do you?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: No.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: That's affirmative. Servo loop Number 2, yaw only.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Roger. And servo loop Number 1 is okay?

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: That's affirmative.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: And did I read that the first time through the servo checks, they were okay? And then when you started to set the yaw trim, the oscillation started, and that once you had the malfunction, it occurred in...

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: It's good, John.

a16_0981049.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: It got him, hadn't it?

a16_0981049.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981049.text: Yeah. Go Auto Track.

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: No, sir. No, sir. Primary loop checked out normally. Secondary loop never checked out in yaw servo.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Roger; copy. And that was both...

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: [Garble] started normally, and it's - Go ahead, Hank.

a16_0981049.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981049.text: Roger. And that occurred both in SCS and G&N, is that correct?

a16_0981049.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981049.text: That's affirmative. And I tried both Auto and Rate Command in SCS.

a16_0981658.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981658.text: Orion, this is Houston. We'd like you to go back to normal RCS configuration. [Pause.]

a16_0981658.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981658.text: Normal RCS config, Charlie; whatever that means.

a16_0981658.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0981658.text: Jim, be advised we had a couple of RCS Reg A lights on the back side, and by flipping the system, it went out. [Pause.]

a16_0981658.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0981658.text: And, Ken, We'd like to confirm that was a divergent oscillation. Is that correct?

a16_0981658.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981658.text: I think he's probably just about out of Mode - Mode 1 limits, John.

a16_0981658.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981658.text: Yeah, I think that's what it is.

a16_0981658.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0981658.text: Wait a minute. Let me park the antenna where it should be.

a16_0981658.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0981658.text: Plus all balls? No, you - there you go, plus.

a16_0981912.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981912.text: Houston, how do you read. Over?

a16_0981912.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981912.text: Orion, this is Houston. Read you loud and clear.

a16_0981912.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981912.text: Okay; I'm prepared to do that right now if you're ready.

a16_0981912.speaker: Mattingly (CM comm)
a16_0981912.text: Okay; I'm prepared to do that right now if you're ready.

a16_0981912.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0981912.text: Okay. I don't think we're going to have a - remeeting problem here, but we're pointed right at him and as I look at him on my LPD, [pause] Ken is out at 46 degrees and about - oh, I'd say 800 or 900 feet, maybe a thousand [300 metres].

a16_0981912.speaker: Irwin
a16_0981912.text: Roger. Can you see those booms that had the problem? [Pause.]

a16_0981912.speaker: Duke [Young in LM transcript] (LM)
a16_0981912.text: Everything is retracted in the SIM bay.

a16_0981912.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0981912.text: This is Apollo Control. We are going around at least one more rev before attempting the Power Descent Initiation for Lunar Module Orion. Ken Mattingly in Command Module Casper encountered some problems in preparing for the Service Propulsion System burn for the circularization maneuver. Seems that a secondary circuit on the Thrust Vector Control System apparently did not come up to specifications. So the circularization burn was aborted, and we have a wave-off. We'll stand by for the remainder of this front-side pass as a new circularization burn maneuver is calculated, and troubleshooting con

a16_0981912.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981912.text: Okay; I'm bringing the Bus Ties on.

a16_0981912.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981912.text: Okay, and ServoPowers 1 and 2 are on in the loop configuration. Are you ready for me to start the gimbals ?

a16_0981912.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0981912.text: Okay, here comes - You just wanted to look at the yaw. Here comes Yaw number 2. There it is, and it's oscillating now, and it's damped out, and that's in Auto. I'll switch it to Number 2, and Number 2 in Auto. I'm now going to move the , and it - Well, now it's - there it goes - now it's oscillating, and it's divergent, and I'm turning the Gimbals Off. Okay, Yaw Gimbal Number 2 is Off. I'll hold this configuration.

a16_0982232.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0982232.text: There's nothing we can do, Charlie. You think?

a16_0982232.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0982232.text: Up to them. Let's see the book.

a16_0982232.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0982232.text: You want - you say you want to go ahead and try it without - without the - without the loops? What do you think?

a16_0982232.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0982232.text: I don't think they do. I bet you they don't.

a16_0982232.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0982232.text: What they'll do. Sock, me a little water.

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0982721.text: Houston, 16.

a16_0982721.speaker: Irwin
a16_0982721.text: Okay, go ahead, 16.

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0982721.text: All right, Jim. You guys working on some more PADs and stuff for us?

a16_0982721.speaker: Irwin
a16_0982721.text: Oh, yeah, we are, Charlie, and when you get a chance we'll take your AGS cal, if you have those.

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0982721.text: Yeah, sure do. Stand by.

a16_0982721.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0982721.text: We'd like to pitch down to keep Ken in sight. Is that possible?

a16_0982721.speaker: Irwin
a16_0982721.text: Okay, you're clear. [Pause.]

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0982721.text: Okay, starting with 540, minus 008, plus 001, plus 002, plus 006, plus 05 - correction plus 045, minus 088, and the initial numbers were the same as on the Data Card Book.

a16_0982721.speaker: Irwin
a16_0982721.text: Okay, beginning - here's the readback, beginning at 540, minus 008, plus 001, plus 002, plus 006, plus 045, minus 088, and the initial values were the same as on the card. Over.

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0982721.text: That's affirmative.

a16_0982721.speaker: Irwin
a16_0982721.text: Okay. And on your RCS situation, we suspect that the burst disk went back side. We'd like to make sure that the System A pressure, when the source pressure in System A gets down to 500 psi, we'd like you to close off System A. Over.

a16_0982721.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0982721.text: Roger. [Pause.]

a16_0982721.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0982721.text: What is it now, Jim?

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM)

a16_0982721.speaker: Irwin
a16_0982721.text: Okay, we copy.

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)

a16_0982721.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0982721.text: The radar problem.

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke/Young (LM onboard)

a16_0982721.speaker: Young (LM onboard)

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0982721.text: Yeah.

a16_0982721.speaker: Young (LM onboard)
a16_0982721.text: Man, I'm ready. I'm ready to go down and land. I think that'd really be neat.

a16_0982721.speaker: Duke (LM onboard)
a16_0982721.text: I bet we dock and come home in about three hours.

a16_0983155.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0983155.text: - Jim, give me a call when you want us to go to Aft Omni.

Over the next several hours this consideration should sort itself out.

a16_0983434.text: Orion, Casper.

a16_0983434.text: Orion, do you read me on B Duplex?

a16_0983434.text: This is Apollo Control at 98:37. The current situation in Apollo 16 is a wave-off. That is another revolution before attempting a landing.

a16_0983434.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0983434.text: Roger. It looks like I'm losing comm with Orion. Could you ask them to go back to A Simplex?

a16_0983434.text: Wilco.

a16_0983434.text: However as mentioned earlier other options are being looked at in case the trouble shooting on the Command Module - Command Service Module Stabilization and Control System fails to pan out to where the circularization burn or any other Service Propulsion System burns could be conducted successfully.

a16_0983434.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0983434.text: Go ahead, Ken.

a16_0983434.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0983434.text: Go ahead, Ken. [Long pause.]

a16_0983434.text: Okay, you were just about unreadable. I don't know if you could pick me up on that other configuration, but that didn't work at all. You're still very scratchy, hardly make you out at all. Yeah, that's pretty bad. That's not much better; it's not near like what we got before. Let's go back to A Simplex.

a16_0983434.speaker: Irwin
a16_0983434.text: Orion, go Forward omni. [Long pause.]

a16_0983434.text: Hey, Charlie.

a16_0983434.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0983434.text: Okay, you want to turn your light on when it gets dark? And how about let's try a little ranging here, before we go into the darkness?

a16_0983434.speaker: MCC
a16_0983434.text: [Garble] CapCom...

a16_0983434.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0983434.text: ...comm now - you're on - on configuration for ranging.

a16_0983434.speaker: MCC
a16_0983434.text: Hey - am I - Hey, Gerry, am I on your loop? Okay. Hey, on - on this conversation here, I ran this rendezvous from the miniball.

a16_0983434.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0983434.text: Hey, Stuart, you're on air-to-ground.

a16_0983434.speaker: MCC
a16_0983434.text: Sorry about that, Ken.

a16_0983434.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0983434.text: Hey, Charlie, let's - hey, Charlie, how about let's try out this ranging? You're in the ranging configuration, right? Okay, stand by for about 30 seconds until I try to lock up.

a16_0983434.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0983434.text: Okay, I've got you at 0.36; 0.38; 0.36, bouncing around. How does that compare? It doesn't really.

a16_0984140.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0984140.text: Okay, that sounds pretty good. [Pause.] Houston, how do you read Orion? Over.

a16_0984140.speaker: Irwin
a16_0984140.text: Read you loud and clear, Orion. [Long pause.]

a16_0984140.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0984140.text: Houston, this is Apollo 16 [garble]. [Long pause.] [Garble] PDI. We'd like to try.

a16_0984140.text: Orion, this is Houston, if you're calling.

a16_0984140.speaker: Young (LM)

a16_0984140.speaker: Irwin
a16_0984140.text: Stand by. We'll tell you.

a16_0984140.speaker: Irwin

a16_0984140.speaker: Young (LM)
a16_0984140.text: Okay. [Pause.] Understand.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0984140.text: This is Apollo Control. There's a rather busy huddle around the Flight Director's console here in Mission Control as all the options for the current situation in the mission are considered. Shall we continue trying to troubleshoot the problem with the Command Service Module Stabilization and Control System or shall we proceed with re-rendezvous and a Trans-Earth Injection burn at several hours hence. The possibility is still open for troubleshooting and fixing the problem with the system that controls the Service Propulsion System, and just landing at a later time. We are hopeful that before L

a16_0984140.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0984140.text: This is Apollo Control. Spacecraft communicator Jim Irwin in the next few moments should pass up to the crew of Orion what the current thinking is here in the Control Room on attacking the problems that have arisen in the Apollo 16 mission.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: Gee, I think so. Might as well keep an eye on it, looks like we're getting ready to go in the dark here. Could you wait until we get in the dark so I can look at you? Right now, I've got the Sun right smack in my eyes.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: Did you get any words out of Houston? I haven't heard a word from them.

a16_0984140.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0984140.text: Casper, Houston. We're working on a problem down here.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: Roger, Henry. I understand that; but I'm not bugging you. We'll stay off the loop.

a16_0984140.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0984140.text: Okay, we've got the data down, and we've got the strip charts, and we're taking a look here and see if we can't find some way to get around it.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: Okay. I know if there's a way, you'll find it.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: Stand by a second.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: Was doing temporary battle with our friend, the trash bag. I have you, visual. Tally ho.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: Okay. I'll keep you in sight.

a16_0984140.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984140.text: That old probe is really nice.

a16_0984942.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0984942.text: Okay. Was attitude - How about looking ahead to see if this attitude is going to hold throughout the test?

a16_0985226.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0985226.text: Yes, sir. I'll go to VOX now and, Orion, are you still working on your [P]52?

a16_0985429.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0985429.text: Okay. I'm going to have my head in the cockpit here for a while, but if Mr. Kepler isn't a high school dropout, why, we won't hit anyhow.

a16_0985429.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0985429.text: This is Apollo Control. Aboard the Command Module Casper, Ken Mattingly is troubleshooting the SCS, reading out what his onboard indications are. Let's listen to that for a while, and switch away from Orion.

a16_0985642.speaker: Mattingly

a16_0985642.speaker: Mattingly

Didn't have the Motor on; turning it Off. I'll turn it on one more time. Okay, it's stable. I'm taking the trim, which is now set at a little over 1 on the thumbwheel, down towards zero. a16_0985642.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0985642.text: It did last time. I now have the Gimbal on again, and I'm going to give it a little Yaw, and there it goes. Coming Off...

a16_0985642.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0985642.text: Mark.

a16_0985642.text: Roger. Copy. [Pause.]

a16_0985642.text: Understand. Stand by.

a16_0985642.text: Roger. Copy.

And which apparently we have as long as five lunar orbits to make a determination on the feasibility of continuing with the landing, or whether we'll have to rendezvous with the two spacecraft back together, and do an immediate return to Earth, assuming that the Service Propulsion System would be inoperative. We're some 14 minutes away from Loss of Signal with the Command Module. We'll monitor the discussion

a16_0985642.text: Okay. I've got - I secured the hand controller by just taking Normal 2 Power to Off, and the rest of the Powers were Off. I'm in Accel Command on Yaw and I'm going Number 2 up to Start, and it's in Accel, and it's stable. Would you like for me to try the thumbwheels?

a16_0985642.text: Stand by one.

a16_0985642.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0985642.text: And with a little excitation from the thumbwheel, it took off again.

a16_0985642.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0985642.text: Roger. Understand. [Long pause.]

a16_0985642.text: Ken, for that rendezvous, we're suggesting you use the procedure you worked on there in the simulator, just moving in when you're at close - closest approach.

a16_0985642.text: Go ahead.

a16_0985642.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0985642.text: Okay, Hank. Will do that. Thank you.

a16_0985642.text: That...

a16_0990730.text: Stand by.

a16_0990730.text: This is Apollo Control at 99 hours, 11 minutes into the mission of Apollo 16. To recap the current situation, the crews of both vehicles, Casper and Orion, have been instructed to station-keep as they come to their closest approach during the next pass behind the Moon, with the Command Service Module being active in the rendezvous. At the sa

a16_0990730.text: Okay. Thank you.

a16_0990730.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0990730.text: This is Apollo Control. One slight correction. We have five revolutions which amounts to ten hours in which to make the decision before the geometry of the two spacecraft orbits would dictate no landing, would be out of plane with the landing site beyond the capability of the Descent Propulsion System to steer into the landing site. To repeat again, that is five revolutions instead of five hours.

a16_0990730.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0990730.text: Casper, Houston. We're about two minutes from LOS, and when you come around next time, in that rendezvous, just come up on the best omni, and then we'll get High Gain from there. [Pause.]

a16_0990730.speaker: Irwin
a16_0990730.text: And, Orion, we're 2 minutes from LOS.

a16_0990730.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0990730.text: Okay, Hank. And is there anything else you can think of we can do - we might try and take a look at? Otherwise, we'll just be station-keeping at a hindred feet or so. [Pause.]

a16_0990730.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0990730.text: Copy, Jim. And we're going to - Updata Link to Off.

a16_0990730.speaker: Hartsfield
a16_0990730.text: We can't think of anything else down here, Ken.

a16_0990730.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0990730.text: Okay. Thank you, sir. See you in a few minutes.

a16_0990730.speaker: Irwin
a16_0990730.text: Orion, we're finished with your computer.

a16_0990730.speaker: Duke (LM)
a16_0990730.text: Roger. Thank you much.

a16_0990730.speaker: Mission Control
a16_0990730.text: This is Apollo Control. We've had Loss of Signal at the end of the - near the end of the 13th lunar revolution as both spacecraft go around the back of the Moon. Flight Director Gerry Griffin is having what he calls a 'tag up' with all of the console positions here in the Control Center for a discussion of the current situation in Apollo 16. We've had a wave-off so far. That is the current posture of the mission. a16_0990730.speaker: Mattingly (CM onboard)
a16_0990730.text: Okay.

a16_0990730.speaker: Mattingly
a16_0990730.text: Okay.

a16_0991703.text: Yeah. I think I'll [garble].
